claude_proposed_widenings.name: activated_nonspell_ongoing_weapon_rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has an activated, resource-gated, dawn-reset weapon coating that persists for a bounded time, ends early on the next qualifying hit, and then resolves a save-gated rider from that later hit. Existing magic-item activation mechanics only resolve phases at activation time; existing ongoing operations exist only on spell families.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: timed_condition_on_save_result
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The later hit applies a condition with its own independent 1-minute duration. Current save results can apply a condition, but there is no way to author that condition's standalone timed duration on a non-spell item rider.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.
